plan.arc: Present one concrete operational reason for an agency managing several shows to consider Transistor, then invite the reader to begin the documented 14-day trial.
plan.sequence_rationale: This single email uses a direct, product-led proposition rather than an unsupported problem story. email.subject: One account, more podcasts
email.preview_text: Add podcasts without a separate charge for creating each one.
email.headline: Host multiple shows in one account
email.body:
When a new client or internal podcast needs a host, you can place it in the same Transistor account as your other shows. A paid account does not add a separate charge for creating each additional podcast.

Transistor is a podcast hosting platform for carrying multiple shows in one account. From there, distribute each podcast to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, Overcast, Pocket Casts and more.

Use that account for the podcasts your agency produces, then publish each one to the listening apps its audience uses.

The free trial runs for 14 days, giving you a defined window to decide whether Transistor fits the hosting plan for your next show.
